name: Pharmaceutical and Syringe Drop-Off Locations in NYC
description:
This dataset lists 339 locations across New York City where residents can drop off pharmaceuticals or used syringes and sharps. Each record identifies the site by name and type (pharmaceuticals drop-off or syringe/sharps drop-off), and includes its street address, borough, ZIP code, phone number, and operating days and hours, with notes on placement or instructions where available. Records also carry neighborhood names and a range of administrative geographies—community district, census tract, council, senate, congressional, assembly, and police districts, plus sanitation zones—along with latitude and longitude coordinates and a point geometry for mapping.

The data covers all five boroughs, with Brooklyn and Queens accounting for the largest shares of sites. Phone numbers, hours, and notes are missing for roughly 40% of rows, and a small number of records lack police precinct, parcel, or building identifiers.

The dataset supports building search or map tools that help residents find nearby disposal sites, analyzing how access to disposal infrastructure varies
